blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A conformal abstention certificate for text-to-SQL is only as truthful as the correctness labels it is calibrated on. The uncertainty pipelines that read confidence off execution consistency take those labels from the single database a benchmark ships, an oracle known to be lenient. We run a preregistered intervention on Spider-Realistic, swapping that database for the benchmark’s distilled multi-instance test suite. Across four SQL-specialist checkpoints and two split schemes, the swap raises the certificate’s held-out risk 2.73 to 10.23 points above the risk its own labels report. Neither oracle reports the risk experts assign. Under blinded labels from two SQL experts, a certificate calibrated at a nominal 0.10 carries 20.0 and 17.2 points of risk on two checkpoints. The stricter oracle errs in both directions: most of the answers it rejects are not judged wrong, and some of those it accepts are. An AI-assigned census of what it rejects finds a semantic error in a quarter to a third of them, depending on the population. It attributes most of the rest to underspecified questions, synthetic instances or suspected reference-query defects, a flag supported by a preregistered blinded expert audit. The oracle also decides how a confidence score is judged. Every execution-consistency score looks better under the labels of the oracle that built its clusters, in 16 of 16 combinations. Under expert labels, building such a score on suite clusters instead of shipped-database clusters raises its area under the ROC curve (AUROC) by 6.96 points on one checkpoint and 1.53 on the other. On the second, the expert interval excludes the 8.3 points the suite labels report. A certificate should be reported with both oracles, and an oracle-relative difference read as semantic risk only after the benchmark is audited. A consistency score should be evaluated under an oracle that did not build it.
blocks.zh: 文本到SQL的一致弃权证书,其真实性与校准的正确性标签相同。 将信心与执行一致性脱节的不确定性管道,从单一数据库中取出这些标签为基准船,这是众所周知的宽大标志。 我们运行一个预先注册的“蜘蛛-真实主义”的干预, 将数据库交换给基准的蒸馏多层测试套件。 在四个SQL-专家检查站和两个拆分办法中,互换使证书被扣留的风险比它自己的标签报告高出2.73至10.23点。 风险专家没有报告。 在两名SQL专家的盲目标签下,以名义0.10校准的证书在两个检查站上有20.0和17.2个危险点。 更严格的预言在两个方向上都是错误的:它拒绝的答案大多没有被判定错误,它接受的答案也有一些. 根据人口的不同,大赦国际指定对它拒绝的内容进行普查,发现其中四分之一至三分之一存在语义错误。 它将其余大部分归结为未明确的问题,合成实例或疑似参考-query缺陷,这是预先注册的失明专家审计支持的旗帜. 先知也决定如何判断一个信心分数. 每个执行一致的分数在构建其集群的神谕的标签下看起来更好,在16个组合中的16个. 在专家标签下,在套件组群上而不是在运出的数据库组群上建立这种分数,使其在ROC曲线(AUROC)下的面积在一个检查站上增加6.96分,另一个检查站增加1.53分。 第二,专家间隔不包括套件标签报告的8.3分。 只有在对基准进行审计后,才能将证书连同两个甲骨文和甲骨文-相对的差别称为语义风险。 一致性分数应在未建立一致性分数的甲骨文下评估。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: A text-to-SQL system answers a natural-language question by generating a query and returning what the database retrieves, and nothing in the result of a wrong query marks it as wrong [ 51 ] . Abstaining on the questions the system is unsure of is one remedy, and a conformal risk certificate makes that abstention a specific promise. Conformal risk control selects a threshold on a calibration set so that the expected value of a bounded, monotone loss is at most a nominal level α \alpha on exchangeable test data [ 5 ] . For abstention the loss is one if the system answers and is wrong, so the promise is that, over questions drawn in the same way as the calibration questions, the marginal probability of returning a wrong answer, with abstentions counted as zero loss, is at most α \alpha . That promise is only as good as the definition of “wrong” used to calibrate it. In the text-to-SQL uncertainty pipelines of Section 2 that read confidence off execution consistency, correctness is judged on one database per schema, by comparing the result of a generated query with the expected one, and where candidates are clustered by whether they return the same result, that database also builds the clusters the confidence score is read off [ 10 , 34 , 42 ] .
blocks.zh: 一个文本到SQL系统通过生成查询并返回数据库检索到的东西来解答一个自然语言的问题,任何错误查询的结果都没有将其标记为错误[51]. 对问题投弃权票,该制度不确定是一种补救办法,而符合要求的风险证书则规定放弃一项具体承诺。 组合式风险控制在一套校准上选择一个阈值,这样,在可交换测试数据上,受限单酮损失的预期值最多只能是名义水平的α α 。 对弃权来说,如果系统回答和错误,则损失是1,因此,承诺是,对于与校准问题相同的问题,返回错误答案的边际概率,以零损失计算,最多为α\α。 这一承诺只是与用来校正“错误”的定义一样好。 在第2节的文本至SQL不确定的管道中,通过将生成的查询结果与预期的查询结果进行比较,在将候选人分组时,如果候选人返回同一结果,该数据库还构建了集群,信任得分读取[10、34、42]。

blocks.en: That oracle has been known to be lenient for years. Text-to-SQL benchmarks moved from exact match to execution accuracy because many correct queries do not match the reference string, and execution on the benchmark’s database counts such queries as correct [ 53 , 30 ] ; execution on one database is lenient in the other direction, because two queries with different meanings can return the same table on the data that happens to be there. Zhong et al. [55] addressed this with distilled test suites, a small set of databases per schema, distilled from many random ones, on which two queries must agree before they count as equivalent, and the Spider leaderboard adopted test-suite accuracy as its official metric later that year; later work has shown by formal verification and by synthesised databases that single-database execution accepts semantically different queries [ 22 , 18 ] . Two pilot measurements on official Spider dev ( Section 3.2 ) set the scale: the shipped databases make the reference queries of 688 pairs of different questions return identical results, of which 0.44 percent survive the suite, and they accept about 7 percent of the reference-query mutations that change the result on some suite instance. Yet the uncertainty pipelines that read confidence off execution consistency still build their signals and judge correctness on one database per schema, and none of them measures what the oracle costs at the certificate layer, or checks whether the stricter oracle’s rejections are semantic errors at all. The second question is one of construct validity, whether a correctness label produced by executing a reference query measures whether the question was answered, and it decides more of the reported risk than the first. A third question follows from the same arrangement: where candidates are clustered by execution result, the oracle that supplies the labels also builds the clusters the confidence score is read from, so an evaluation of that score under that oracle cannot separate a score that predicts correctness better from one that agrees with the oracle that defined it, and none of the pipelines that cluster candidates evaluates such a score under an oracle that did not build its clusters.
blocks.zh: 这个神谕多年来一直很宽大 文本到SQL的基准从精确匹配到执行的准确性,因为许多正确的查询不匹配参考字符串,基准数据库上的执行算上这样的查询是正确的[53,30];一个数据库上的执行在另一个方向上是宽松的,因为两个不同含义的查询可以在恰巧存在的数据上返回同一个表格. 钟等. [55] 这个问题用蒸馏测试套件来解决,每套测试套件是一小套数据库,从许多随机的套件中提炼出来,两个查询在算作等价之前必须达成一致,蜘蛛领板在当年晚些时候采用了测试套件精度作为其官方的度量标准;后来的工作通过正式核实和综合数据库显示,单数据库执行接受的查询与众不同[22,18]. 在官方Spider dev(第3.2节)上的两个试点测量设定了尺度: 运出的数据库对688对不同问题的参考查询返回了相同的结果,其中0.44%在套房中存活,他们接受了大约7%的参考-query突变,这些突变在某些套房实例上改变了结果. 然而,从执行一致性中读取信心的不确定性管道仍然在每一个计划上建立信号并判断正确性,而且没有一个程序能衡量证书层的甲骨文成本,或检查更严格的甲骨文的拒绝是否完全是语义错误。 第二个问题是构造有效性问题,是否通过执行参考查询措施产生的正确性标签是否回答了问题,它决定的所报告的风险比第一个风险多。 第三个问题来自同样的安排:如果候选人被执行结果组合在一起,提供标签的神谕也构建了集群,信任分从中读取,因此在神谕下对这个分数的评价无法将一个更能预测正确性的分数与一个同意它定义的神谕的分数分开,而将候选人组合在一起的管道没有一个在没有构建其集群的神谕下评价这样的分数.

blocks.en: We run a preregistered two-by-two intervention on the oracle of the simplest execution-based certificate: sample fifty candidates per question, partition them into execution-equivalence classes, score a question by the mass of its largest class, and select an abstention threshold by split-half conformal risk control at α = 0.10 \alpha=0.10 . The partition and the correctness labels can each use the shipped database or every instance of the distilled suite, giving four cells; cell A \mathrm{A} follows current practice in using the shipped database for both, and cell D \mathrm{D} is fully multi-instance. GAP \mathrm{GAP} is the held-out risk that cell A \mathrm{A} carries under the suite oracle minus the held-out risk it carries under its own weak labels, at the threshold its calibration selected; it is the understatement a practitioner who evaluates on the shipped database never sees. D − A \mathrm{D}{-}\mathrm{A} is the suite-oracle risk of cell D \mathrm{D} minus that of cell A \mathrm{A} . The panel is four SQL-specialist checkpoints from two Qwen lineages, evaluated on all 508 questions of Spider-Realistic with three generation seeds each, 200 split-halves under two split schemes and a false-schema negative control. Post hoc, the intervention is repeated for five published confidence scores under the identical certificate, every answer the suite rejects is labelled in a two-pass adjudicated audit by one AI reviewer family, and the certificate is re-scored under nested relabelling conventions. Two preregistered blinded audits by two SQL experts then supply labels no oracle produced: one tests the census’s suspected reference-defect label at the question level, the other judges every distinct answer two checkpoints return at one seed, blind to both oracles.
blocks.zh: 我们对最简单的执行证书的甲骨文进行预先注册的二比二的干预:每个问题抽样50名候选人,将他们分为执行等效等级,按其最大等级的质量分一个问题,用半分法风险控制选择一个弃权阈值为α=0.10\alpha=0.10。 分区和正确性标签可以分别使用已运出的数据库或蒸馏套件的每一个实例,给出四个单元格;单元格 A\mathrm{A}遵循当前同时使用已运出数据库的做法,单元格 D\mathrm{D}是完全多层的. GAP\ mathrm{ GAP} 是单元格 A\ mathrm{ A} 在套件甲骨文下所携带的悬浮风险减去它在自己弱标签下所携带的悬浮风险, 在它所选择的校准阈值下; 它是在运出的数据库上评价的操作者从未看到过的低报. D − A \ mathrm{D}{- { mathrm{A} 是单元格 D\ mathrm{D} 减去单元格 A\ mathrm{A} 的套接字风险。 小组由来自两个昆族的4个SQL-专家检查站组成,对所有508个蜘蛛-真菌学问题进行评估,每问题有3代种子,200个在两个分裂计划下分裂的胡萝卜,以及一个假的Schema负控制. 事后临时,在相同的证书下,5个已公布的置信分数重复干预,每一份被套件拒绝的回答都由一个AI审查者家族在双通过裁定的审计中贴上标签,证书在嵌入式重贴标签的常规下重新记分. 两名SQL专家预先注册了两次盲目审计,然后提供了没有甲骨文的标签:一次在问题一级测试普查怀疑的参考缺陷标签,其他法官则每一次明确回答两个检查站,一次在一种子下返回,两次都看不到甲骨文。

blocks.en: Which oracle labels the calibration set decides the risk the certificate reports, and neither oracle reports the risk two SQL experts assign ( Figure 1 a). In the preregistered analysis the swap raises the held-out risk of the current-practice certificate 2.73 to 10.23 points above the risk it reports under its own labels, on every checkpoint, seed and split scheme, and the fully multi-instance cell carries less suite-oracle risk in every case, by more than the preregistered three points on Kwai-32B, Kwai-14B and Omni-32B but not on XiYan-32B; the post-hoc extension to six confidence scores gives the same picture for every score ( Figure 1 b, preregistered suite labels).
blocks.zh: 由哪个甲骨文标注校准集决定证书报告的风险,两个甲骨文都没有报告两位SQL专家指定的风险(图1a)。 在预先登记的分析中,互换将当前做法证书2.73至10.23点的风险提高至在自己标签下报告的每个检查站、种子和拆分办法的风险,而完全多功能单元在每一种情况下都承担较少的套房风险,在Kwai-32B、Kwai-14B和Omni-32B上比预先登记的3点多,但在XiYan-32B上却不是;6个信任分数之后的扩展给每个分数都提供了相同的情况(图1b,预先登记的套房标签)。

blocks.en: Most of what the suite rejects is not a semantic error. The AI audit assigns that label to 26.1 percent of the answers the shipped database accepts and the suite rejects, and to 35.0 percent of all rejected answers, and attributes the rest to underspecified questions, synthetic instances, comparator artefacts or suspected defects in the benchmark’s own reference queries ( Figure 1 c). A preregistered blinded expert audit supports the reference-defect flag: two SQL experts judge 54.8 percent of the flagged questions defective against 20.0 percent of an examined control, a margin of 34.8 points where the preregistered rule asks for 25, and a post-hoc design-weighted estimate places a defective reference query on 17.5 percent of the 508 questions.
blocks.zh: 套房拒绝的大多不是语义错误. AI审计将标签分配给26.1%的发送数据库接受和拒绝的答案,以及35.0%的被拒绝答案,并将其余部分归结为指定不足的问题、合成实例、参照物或基准本身参考查询中的疑似缺陷(图1c)。 预先注册的失明专家审计支持参考缺陷标志:两名SQL专家判断54.8%的标注问题与20.0%的检查控制有缺陷,预注册规则要求25的比值为34.8分,以及事后设计加权估计对508个问题的17.5%有缺陷的参考查询.

blocks.en: The suite also accepts answers that are wrong, and relabelling only the rejected side with the full census reverses the sign of the understatement for every checkpoint ( Figure 1 b). Expert labels on both sides, on XiYan-32B and Kwai-32B, fix it as positive under every convention: those experts call wrong 17.7 and 15.1 percent of the answers the suite accepts, against 36.8 and 36.3 percent of those it rejects. Neither oracle reports the level those labels give. A certificate calibrated at a nominal 0.10 carries 20.0 points of expert-judged risk on XiYan-32B and 17.2 on Kwai-32B; the shipped database understates that on both checkpoints, and the suite understates it on XiYan-32B while overstating it on Kwai-32B ( Figure 1 a). The multi-instance cell carries less risk under every yardstick, and it gets there by changing which questions are answered: the two partitions return the same SQL on 97.1 percent of answers.
blocks.zh: 套房还接受错误的答案,只将被拒绝的一方重新贴上完整的人口普查标签,颠倒每个检查站的低报符号(图1b). 在西洋32B和桂32B两侧的专家标签中, 任何甲骨文都无法报告标签给出的级别. 标定在名义0.10的证书载有西安-32B和桂-32B的20.0点专家判断的风险;所运数据库低估了两个检查站的风险,套房则在西安-32B上低估了风险,同时夸大了桂-32B的风险(图1a)。 多层单元格在每个尺度下的风险都比较小,它通过改变回答哪些问题而到达:两个分区在97.1%的答案上返回相同的SQL.

blocks.en: The oracle also decides how a confidence score is judged. Each execution-consistency score looks better under the labels of the oracle that built its clusters, in 16 of 16 score-by-checkpoint combinations, while likelihood scores that read no oracle never do. Under suite labels the score built on the suite partition leads by about nine points of AUROC on both audited checkpoints; under expert labels that lead holds on Kwai-32B, 6.96 points at p = 0.004 p=0.004 , and on XiYan-32B the expert interval, − 1.2 -1.2 to 4.3 points, excludes the 8.3 points the suite labels report. Either oracle agrees with the experts on only 74 to 80 percent of the answers the two experts agree on. An oracle-internal gain therefore does not by itself establish a gain under an independent yardstick.
blocks.zh: 先知也决定如何判断一个信心分数. 每个执行一致的得分在构建其集群的神谕的标签下看起来更好,在16分的逐个检查点组合中的16分中,而读不出神谕的概率分数从不做. 在套房标签下,两个经审计的检查站的套房分隔线上的分数分别是大约9分的AUROC;在Kwai-32B上领先的专家标签下,6.96分为p=0.004 p=0.004;在XiYan-32B上,专家间隔为1.2-1.2至4.3分,不包括套房标签报告的8.3分。 两位专家只同意74%至80%的答案。 因此,在独立标准下,内部收益本身并不能确定收益。

blocks.en: 1. We show that the risk a conformal abstention certificate for text-to-SQL reports is set by the execution oracle that labels its calibration set. In a preregistered intervention on Spider-Realistic with four SQL-specialist checkpoints, swapping the benchmark’s shipped database for its distilled multi-instance test suite raises the certificate’s held-out risk 2.73 to 10.23 points above the risk its own labels report ( Section 4 ). 2. We audit both oracles against labels from outside them. An AI-labelled census of every answer the stricter oracle rejects attributes most rejections to the benchmark rather than to the system, and a preregistered blinded expert audit supports its reference-defect flag. Blinded expert labels on both sides of the oracle show, post hoc, that a certificate calibrated at a nominal 0.10 carries 20.0 and 17.2 points of risk on two checkpoints, a level neither oracle reports ( Sections 5 , 6 and 7 ). 3. We show that the oracle also decides how an execution-consistency score is judged, and test this against an independent yardstick. Each such score looks better under the labels of the oracle that built its clusters, in 16 of 16 combinations, and in a preregistered blinded expert audit the AUROC gain that suite labels report for building the score on suite clusters holds on one checkpoint and falls outside the expert interval on the other ( Sections 7.2 and 7.3 ).

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Since the distilled test suites of Zhong et al. [55] , work on the oracle has both quantified the failures of single-database execution and proposed evaluation-side alternatives. On the first, Kim et al. [21] quantified the false positives and false negatives of execution matching against expert judgement, and Ascoli et al. [6] did so under semantic analysis. On the second, Klopfenstein et al. [22] used formal verification to search for a database that separates two queries the shipped database cannot, and Habibollah and Rafiei [18] synthesised databases for the same purpose. Tremante et al. [46] mined schema constraints so that the separating database a verifier returns is one a real deployment could hold, which is the concern that our synthetic-instance-defect label of Section 3.6 records case by case. Separately, and as a candidate-selection method rather than an evaluation-side tool, Li et al. [28] synthesised a minimal distinguishing database at inference time to select among generated SQL candidates. Two of these works already examine what a stricter oracle rejects: Klopfenstein et al. [22] manually inspected the counterexamples its verifier found for a sample of fifty generated queries and attributed each difference to an ambiguous question, an incorrect reference query or an incorrect generated query, reporting the reference at fault more often than the model, and Kim et al. [21] decomposed the false negatives of execution matching against expert judgement. We carry that observation from fifty inspected queries to a census of every rejected answer of four checkpoints under five labels, and test the label that carries the most weight in a preregistered blinded human audit. The test suites have also served as a calibration label: Stengel-Eskin and Van Durme [45] found a T5-base text-to-SQL parser on the Spider test set far less miscalibrated against test-suite accuracy than against exact match. None of this work has been carried into the layer that certifies a system’s risk, which is where our intervention acts. Nor does any of it ask whether a confidence score built on one oracle can be evaluated under that oracle at all.

[28] 在推论时间综合了一个最小的区分数据库,在生成的SQL候选中进行选择. 其中两部著作已经研究了更严格的先知所拒绝的: Klopfenstein et al. 中国植物物种信息数据库. [22] 手动检查了为50个生成的查询样本所发现的校对者,并将每个差异归结为一个模棱两可的问题,不正确的参考查询或错误生成的查询,比模型更经常的错报参考,Kim等人. [21]解析了与专家判断相匹配的死刑执行假负数. 我们从50次检查的查询到对5个标签下的4个检查站的每个被拒绝的答复进行普查,并测试预先登记的盲目审计中最重的标签。 测试套件也作为校准标签:Stengel-Eskin和Van Durme[45]在蜘蛛测试套件上发现了一个T5基文本对SQL的解析器,比精确匹配的测试套件精确度差得多. 所有这些工作都没有进入证明一个系统的风险的层层,而这正是我们的干预行动所在。 也没有人会问,在一个甲骨文上建立的信任分数是否可以在甲骨文下评估。

blocks.en: Annotation errors in text-to-SQL benchmarks are documented. Pourreza and Rafiei [39] re-evaluated Spider-family predictions by hand and analysed BIRD systematically, finding that underspecified questions and defective reference queries account for a large share of the disagreements between models and benchmarks. Wretblad et al. [50] examined noise in BIRD and found reference queries and questions that experts would not accept, and Jin et al. [20] corrected annotation errors with experts and measured their effect on leaderboard rankings. Spider’s original exact-match metric did not evaluate literal values [ 53 ] , so a wrongly cased literal in a reference query was invisible to it on a case-sensitive engine. Outside text-to-SQL, Northcutt et al. [38] showed that label errors in test sets are pervasive and that modest increases in their prevalence would reverse model selection. Conformal prediction has its own literature on what a certificate means when the calibration labels are noisy: Einbinder et al. [14] showed that under dispersive noise the certificate remains valid but conservative, and Sesia et al. [43] adapted conformal classification to noisy labels. This paper carries oracle validity into the certificate layer: it reports how much of what the stricter oracle rejects is attributable to the reference queries rather than to the system, validates the suspected-defect label with human experts under a preregistered protocol, and measures what that validity does to the risk a certificate reports.
blocks.zh: 文本到SQL基准的注释错误被记录下来. Pourreza和Rafiei[39]用手重新评价了蜘蛛家族的预测,并对BIRD进行了系统分析,发现在模型和基准之间的分歧中,规格不足的问题和缺陷的参考查询占很大比例. Wretblad 等 (英语). [50] 研究了BIRD中的噪声,发现了专家不会接受的参考查询和问题,Jin等人. [20] 与专家校正注释错误,并衡量其对领导板排名的影响. Spider最初精确匹配的度量衡没有评价字面值[53],因此一个参考查询中错误的语句在对案例敏感的引擎上是看不见的. 外部的文本对SQL,Northcutt等人[38]显示,测试集中的标签错误很普遍,其流行程度的适度提高会逆转模型选择. 校准标签响亮时, Einbinder等人[14]表明,在弥散的噪声下,证书仍然有效,但较为保守,Sesia等人[43] 调整了符合要求的分类,以适应吵闹的标签。 本文将甲骨文有效性带入证书层:它报告更严格的甲骨文拒绝接受的多少可归因于参考查询而不是系统,根据预先登记的协议与人类专家验证可疑缺陷标签,并衡量该有效性对证书报告的风险有何影响。

blocks.en: Confidence estimation for text-to-SQL has been studied with black-box consistency signals, white-box token probabilities and execution-grounded features [ 34 ] , and with parser-independent error detectors built on structural features of the question and the query [ 11 ] and entropy-based selective classifiers [ 44 ] . Calibration has been applied post hoc, by rescaling sequence probabilities [ 41 ] or by sub-clause frequencies [ 32 ] , and execution-consistency sampling has been given an adaptive stopping rule [ 2 ] . Richardson [42] compared these signals as selective predictors and computed a distribution-free selective-risk certificate that triggers only at the loosest risk target on their generator; Ziletti and D’Ambrosi [56] separated ambiguity from instability in a clinical setting; Tritto et al. [47] verified candidates with outcome reward models. Abstention with guarantees reached text-to-SQL through conformal branch prediction at schema linking [ 9 ] and, end to end, through execution entropy with a conformal layer on top [ 10 ] ; Lee et al. [27] scored reliability with penalties for wrong answers, and Wu [51] argued for structural abstention where answers are consumed as fact. None of them labels correctness with a multi-instance oracle, and those that execute queries do so on a single database per schema. Our system under test is deliberately the simplest member of this family, self-consistency mass with conformal risk control, so that the oracle rather than the method is the variable, and the five other scores we test are the black-box members of the family under one certificate.
blocks.zh: 对文本到SQL的置信度估计进行了研究,有黑箱一致性信号,白箱符号概率和基于执行的特性[34],还有基于问题的结构特征和查询[11]和基于Entropy的选择性分类器[44]的解剖器独立错误探测器. 通过调整序列概率[41]或通过子密闭频率[32],在事后进行了校准,执行一致性取样被赋予了适应性的停止规则[2]。 Richardson [42] 将这些信号比作选择性预测器,并计算出一种无分布选择性风险证书,该证书只在发电机上最宽松的风险目标触发;Ziletti和D ' Ambrosi [56] 在临床环境中将模糊性与不稳定性区分开来;Tritto等人。 [47] 经核实具有结果奖励模式的候选人。 在连接[9]的图案中,不提供保证通过向导分支预测达到文本对SQL,最后通过执行在顶端有向导层的向导[10];李等人[27]通过对错误答案的处罚获得可靠性,吴[51]主张结构性弃权,如果答案被作为事实消耗。 其中没有一个将正确性标签为多层甲骨文,而执行查询者则在单个数据库中逐一标注. 我们被测试的系统是这个家族中故意最简单的成员,自我一致的质量与符合性的风险控制,因此神谕而不是方法是可变的,我们测试的其他五个分数是在一个证书下的家庭黑盒成员.

blocks.en: Conformal risk control extends split conformal prediction to expected control of monotone losses [ 5 ] , and the learn-then-test framework gives high-probability control of more general risks [ 4 , 3 ] . Conformal abstention has been developed for language models outside text-to-SQL: Abbasi Yadkori et al. [1] calibrated an abstention rule on a similarity-based self-consistency score with a distribution-free bound on the hallucination rate, Quach et al. [40] calibrated the sampling and filtering of candidate generations so that the returned set contains an acceptable one with a guaranteed probability, and Mohri and Hashimoto [37] filtered the claims of a generation so that what remains is factual with a guaranteed probability. On the limits of such rules, Kotte [23] showed that, when the base risk μ \mu of a generator exceeds α \alpha , any distribution-free method must abstain on a fraction of at least ( μ − α ) / ( 1 − α ) (\mu-\alpha)/(1-\alpha) of inputs, Xu et al. [52] calibrated abstention geometrically, and Marques F. [36] gave the law of the empirical coverage of split conformal prediction, which we use to read resplit variability. The methods of Abbasi Yadkori et al. [1] , Quach et al. [40] and Mohri and Hashimoto [37] take their correctness labels from a reference or a judge and treat them as given; what the certificate carries when that label comes from a lenient execution oracle is what Section 4 measures.

[40] 校准了候选一代的取样和过滤,使返回的一组包含一个可接受且有保证概率的样本,莫赫里和桥本[37]过滤了一代人的要求,使剩下的内容具有保证概率的事实. 在这些规则的限度上,Kotte [23] 表明,当一个发电机的基值风险 μ\ mu 超过 α\ alpha 时,任何无分配方法必须至少弃用一小部分( μ− α ) / ( 1− α ) (\ mu-\ alpha) / ( 1-\ alpha) 投入, Xu 等人. [52] 校准弃权几何法,Marques F. [36] 给出了分形结构预测的经验覆盖法,我们用它来读取重分裂变异法. Abbsi Yadkori等人的方法。 [1], Quach 等人著. [40] 和Mohri和桥本[37] 从参考文献或法官那里取出他们的正确性标签,并视其为给定的标签;当该标签来自宽大的执行神谕时,证书所携带的就是第4节的措施。

blocks.en: The scores we compare come from the general literature on black-box uncertainty for language models: self-consistency mass [ 49 ] , discrete semantic entropy [ 26 , 16 ] , the degree measure of Lin et al. [31] and the set count [ 26 , 31 ] , and length-normalised sequence log-probability [ 35 ] ; implementations of these score families are available in UQLM [ 7 ] and LM-Polygraph [ 15 ] , and functional entropy transfers the semantic-cluster idea to code without executing it [ 8 ] . That the choice of correctness function changes AUROC and the ranking of uncertainty methods is known outside text-to-SQL: Ielanskyi et al. [19] showed that approximate correctness functions disagree with one another enough to reorder methods and to inflate a method’s apparent performance. What is specific here is that the execution oracle does not only supply the labels; it also builds the clusters the four consistency scores are read from, so the label and the score are not independent; Section 7.2 measures that coupling as a signed oracle-by-partition interaction and Section 7.3 tests it against labels neither oracle produced.

[19] 表明,大致正确性函数彼此不一致,足以重订方法的顺序并提升方法的表面性能。 这里的具体规定是,执行甲骨文不仅提供标签;它还构建了四个一致性分数从中读取的集群,因此标签和分数不独立;第7.2节的量度将组合成一个签名的甲骨文逐段交互,第7.3节对照两个生成的甲骨文的标签进行测试.

blocks.zh: 3 实验设计

blocks.en: This section fixes everything the intervention holds constant. Section 3.1 defines the system under test, a self-consistency score over execution-equivalence classes with a split-half conformal certificate on top, and Section 3.2 the two oracles that can supply those classes and the correctness labels. Section 3.3 crosses the two choices into four cells and names the two quantities this paper reports; Figure 2 shows where in the pipeline each choice acts. Sections 3.4 and 3.5 give the pools and the rules frozen before any of them was generated, Section 3.6 the protocol that labels what the stricter oracle rejects, and Section 3.7 the analysis choices that were declared rather than preregistered.

blocks.en: 3.1 The system under test
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 测试中的系统

blocks.en: For a question q q over a schema, the generator draws m = 50 m=50 candidate SQL queries S q S_{q} independently at temperature 1.0 and top- p p 0.95. An execution oracle O O maps a query to a result signature on a set of database instances; two candidates are execution-equivalent under O O if the official test-suite comparator of Zhong et al. [55] judges their results equal on every instance of O O , with the row-order flag set when the reference query of q q carries an ORDER BY . A union-find pass over the pairwise comparisons partitions the usable candidates, those that parse and were not truncated, into execution-equivalence classes Π O ​ ( S q ) \Pi_{O}(S_{q}) . The system answers with the representative of the largest class, and its confidence score is the mass of that class, s O ​ ( q ) = max C ∈ Π O ​ ( S q ) ⁡ | C | | usable candidates of ​ q | , s_{O}(q)=\frac{\max_{C\in\Pi_{O}(S_{q})}|C|}{\lvert\text{usable candidates of }q\rvert}, the self-consistency score of Wang et al. [49] on execution classes. The preregistered construction is an offline benchmark analysis: the reference query takes part in the union-find, and the row-order flag is read from it. A deployed system has no reference query, so the operational definition of the score is the gold-free construction: the partition is built from the sampled candidates alone, the row-order flag is set when either query of the compared pair carries an ORDER BY , and the reference query is used only to label a class after the partition exists. Section 4.5 reports what the preregistered and the gold-free constructions differ by, together with an intermediate construction that isolates the cost of reading the flag per pair. A class is correct under an oracle O ′ O^{\prime} if its representative agrees with the reference query on every instance of O ′ O^{\prime} . blocks.en: 3.2 The two oracles
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 两个先知

blocks.en: The weak oracle is the single database the benchmark ships with each schema, the oracle of the text-to-SQL uncertainty pipelines of Section 2 that read confidence off execution consistency. The multi-instance suite oracle is the distilled test suite of Zhong et al. [55] : for the 19 schemas of Spider-Realistic, 651 distilled instances, between 24 and 59 per schema, plus the shipped database, 670 database files in all, on every one of which two queries must agree. The suite label refines the weak label: a class the suite accepts is accepted by the shipped database, and we verified that no class in the study is accepted by the suite and rejected by the shipped database. Two pilot measurements on official Spider dev, 1,034 questions over 20 schemas, motivated the intervention. First, a collision census: for every pair of different questions on the same schema whose reference queries return identical order-conditional canonical results on the shipped database, 688 pairs, we re-executed both on every suite instance; 3 pairs agree everywhere, so 0.44 percent of the collisions survive the suite. Second, a near-miss census: we applied single-edit mutations to reference queries (dropping a conjunct, swapping an aggregate, flipping a comparison, dropping DISTINCT , changing the ordering direction and similar edits), executed the 856 mutants on every instance, and kept the 832 whose result differs from the original on at least one suite instance; under an order-conditional canonical comparison of results, the shipped database alone accepts 7.0 percent of those as equivalent to the original. Both are computed from reference queries, the first on pairs of them and the second on their mutants; the intervention measures the model’s candidates.

blocks.en: The partition that defines the score and the labels that calibrate the threshold can each come from the weak oracle or from the suite, giving four cells. Cell A \mathrm{A} , weak partition and weak labels, is current practice. Cell B \mathrm{B} keeps the weak partition and calibrates on suite labels; cell C \mathrm{C} builds the partition from the suite and calibrates on weak labels; cell D \mathrm{D} is fully multi-instance. Every cell is evaluated under the suite oracle. Two quantities summarise the intervention, both in percentage points of held-out empirical marginal risk: GAP = R s ​ ( A ) − R w ​ ( A ) , D − A = R s ​ ( D ) − R s ​ ( A ) , \mathrm{GAP}=R^{\mathrm{s}}(\mathrm{A})-R^{\mathrm{w}}(\mathrm{A}),\qquad\mathrm{D}{-}\mathrm{A}=R^{\mathrm{s}}(\mathrm{D})-R^{\mathrm{s}}(\mathrm{A}), where R O ​ ( X ) R^{O}(X) is the held-out empirical marginal risk of cell X X under oracle O O at the threshold its calibration selected, averaged over splits and seeds. The estimand is descriptive: the three-seed mean over 200 split-halves of this fixed benchmark and these pools. The 200 splits overlap, so the sign shares reported with every contrast describe resplit stability and are not confidence levels, and no inference to other questions or schemas is claimed beyond the schema-disjoint stress test of the database splits. The certificate itself promises only the nominal bound α \alpha ; R w ​ ( A ) R^{\mathrm{w}}(\mathrm{A}) is what a practitioner who evaluates on the shipped database measures, and GAP \mathrm{GAP} is the amount by which that measurement understates the risk under the suite oracle. It is non-negative by construction because the suite label refines the weak label. D − A \mathrm{D}{-}\mathrm{A} is the change in suite-oracle risk from moving to the fully multi-instance cell, negative when cell D \mathrm{D} carries less.

blocks.en: The main data are all 508 questions of Spider-Realistic [ 13 ] , the paraphrased subset of Spider dev [ 53 ] over 19 schemas; a matched control uses the one-to-one paired original questions. The checkpoint panel ( Table 1 ) was chosen by a frozen entry rule on a disjoint pilot of 200 Spider dev questions: parse rate at least 0.98, truncation rate at most 0.01, and top-1 accuracy under the suite oracle at least 0.75. Four SQL-specialist checkpoints entered, from two Qwen lineages: Kwai-AutoSQL-32B and Kwai-AutoSQL-14B, fine-tuned from Qwen3 [ 25 , 24 ] , and XiYanSQL-QwenCoder-32B-2504 [ 33 ] , from the Qwen2.5 lineage, and OmniSQL-32B [ 29 ] , fine-tuned from Qwen2.5-Coder. SQLCoder-70B-alpha was excluded at 0.67 on the pilot, and llama-3-sqlcoder-8b produced no parseable output under two inference back-ends; the Meta lineage has no member in the panel. Each checkpoint has three generation seeds, 101, 202 and 303, giving twelve pools of 508 questions and 50 samples, 304,800 generations in all, plus one false-schema control pool per checkpoint in which each question is paired with the schema of an unrelated database. Parse rates are at least 0.9985 and no generation was truncated in any main pool.

blocks.en: The panel, the seeds, the two split schemes, the entry rule and the aggregation rule were frozen before any pool of the panel was generated, in the third of three preregistrations; the first two, on one checkpoint, are described in Appendix A . The frozen rule declares GAP \mathrm{GAP} positive for a checkpoint if every seed is above zero and the three-seed mean is at least 0.010 under both split schemes, and declares the D − A \mathrm{D}{-}\mathrm{A} contrast passed if every seed is below zero and the mean is at most − 0.030 -0.030 under both schemes, robustly passed if every seed is at most − 0.030 -0.030 ; a lineage is judged by its highest-ranked member. The registration’s outcome table names the results: O1 if at least two lineages have positive GAP \mathrm{GAP} and at least two pass the D − A \mathrm{D}{-}\mathrm{A} bar with one robust pass, O2 if at least two lineages have positive GAP \mathrm{GAP} but fewer than two pass the bar or none passes robustly, O4 if no new lineage has positive GAP \mathrm{GAP} , and O5 if no candidate enters. The realised outcome is O2 under the frozen code. The instrument is checked at every tier by parse rate, truncation rate and the false-schema control, whose preregistered expectation is a suite top-1 accuracy at most 0.10 and a cell- A \mathrm{A} suite risk at most α + 0.02 \alpha+0.02 . Apart from the analyses that the two expert audits preregistered ( Appendices G and H ), all analyses beyond the preregistered result, including the alpha curves, the frontier, the exhaustive database splits, the cross-fit, the gold-free construction, the six-score comparison, both censuses, both audit ladders, the decomposition of the D − A \mathrm{D}{-}\mathrm{A} contrast and the oracle-alignment finding, are post hoc and are labelled so where they appear. blocks.en: 3.6 The census protocol
blocks.zh: 3.6 国家 普查程序

blocks.en: To learn what the suite’s rejections are, we labelled, post hoc, every answer it rejects in two populations. For each distinct case, a question together with the returned SQL, a mechanical step first re-executed the reference query and the returned query on the shipped database and on every suite instance with the same comparator and row-order convention as the analysis, and recorded the first instance on which they disagree, the two result tables truncated to twelve rows, a difference signature (row order only, duplicate multiplicity only, different column count, one result a subset of the other, partial overlap, disjoint, one side empty), and surface features of both queries. A dossier then presented each case with its question, both queries, the disagreement breadth and both tables, followed by the full schema, so that a labeller could judge without opening the benchmark.
blocks.zh: 为了了解该套房的拒绝是什么,我们贴上了临时的标签,它拒绝的每一个答案都来自两个群体。 对于每个不同的情况,一个问题连同返回的SQL,一个机械步骤首先在运出的数据库和每个套件实例上重新执行参考查询和返回的查询,与分析相同,并记录了它们不同意的第一种情况,两个结果表缩写为十二行,一个差异签名(只排顺序,只重复复数,不同列数,一个结果一个子集,部分重叠,脱节,一个侧空),以及两个查询的表面特征. 然后,一份档案材料提出了每个案件的问题,既包括询问、分歧的广度,也包括两个表格,然后是完整的计划,这样标签员就可以在不打开基准的情况下作出判断。

blocks.en: Labels were assigned by an AI reviewer, Codex running gpt-5.6-sol, in two independent passes that read the same dossier and could not see each other: the second pass re-batched the cases so that no case kept its neighbours, and listed the taxonomy in reverse order, to counter within-batch anchoring and list-order preference, the latter a documented bias of language-model evaluators [ 54 , 48 ] . On the full census the second pass was also told that 472 of the 742 cases already disagree on the shipped database, where a synthetic-instance-defect label would call the benchmark’s own database defective ( Appendix C ). A third fresh thread adjudicated every disagreement with both labels and both rationales in view. Every label came from these passes and the adjudicating thread. The taxonomy has five labels: semantic error (the returned query answers the question wrongly), underspecified question (the question does not fix the point on which the two queries differ), suspected reference-query defect (the reference is the worse rendering of the question), synthetic-instance defect (the two queries differ only on values a real database of that schema would not contain), and comparator artefact (same information, judged unequal). For semantic errors an error type was also recorded. The labeller is one AI reviewer family and is not the Qwen family of the tested generators; of the five labels, human SQL experts have tested only the suspected reference-query defect, in the preregistered blinded audit of Appendix G . The agreement statistics of Section 5.2 measure the reproducibility of the labelling, not its correctness.

blocks.en: 3.7 Declared design choices
blocks.zh: 3.7 申报的设计选择

blocks.en: Three choices affect how the numbers should be read. First, the score divides by the number of usable candidates, a statistic of the model’s own output; the alternative budget denominator, which divides by all 50 samples and treats unusable ones as implicit abstention mass, changes the question-split GAP \mathrm{GAP} and D − A \mathrm{D}{-}\mathrm{A} by at most 0.14 points on the main pools, where at least 99.85 percent of candidates are usable. Second, 53 of 12,192 top-class decisions are tied, and the frozen analyser and the per-question files it archived break those ties differently; every recomputation from those files, including both censuses, the audit ladders and the six-score comparison, follows the file order, and recomputing every reported GAP \mathrm{GAP} and D − A \mathrm{D}{-}\mathrm{A} under the frozen rule moves no value by more than 0.085 points and changes no sign ( Appendix B ). Third, all four cells share one answer rule, the representative of the largest class, so the six-score comparison compares six abstention rules of one system, not six end-to-end methods; and the four consistency scores share the equivalence relation under test, so only the two likelihood scores are independent of it.
blocks.zh: 三种选择影响数字应如何读取。 首先,分数除以可用候选人数,这是模型自身产出的统计;替代预算分母,将所有50个样本除以不可使用样本,并视同隐含的弃权质量,将问题分解的GAP\mathrm{GAP}和D−A\mathrm{D}{-}\mathrm{A}在主池最多0.14分,其中至少99.85%的候选人可用。 其次,12 192项最高级决定中有53项是捆绑的,所存档的冻结分析器和每个问题文件以不同方式打破了这些联系;从这些文件中,包括人口普查、审计阶梯和六分比较的每次重算都遵循文件顺序,并重算所报的GAP\mathrm{GAP}和D−A\mathrm{D}{-}\mathrm{A}在冻结规则下,不移动价值超过0.085分,不改变标志(附录B)。 第三,所有四个单元格都共享一个答案规则,即最大类的代表,所以六分比较比较一个系统的六弃规则,而不是六个端对端方法;四个一致性分数在测试下共享等效关系,所以只有两个概率分数独立于它.

blocks.zh: 页:1 甲骨文互换更改证书报告的内容

blocks.en: This section reports the preregistered measurement, with its post-hoc robustness checks. The multi-instance suite oracle is the yardstick throughout, and risk is held-out empirical risk under the named oracle at the threshold each cell’s calibration selected.

blocks.en: Table 2 gives the preregistered result. For every checkpoint, every generation seed and both split schemes, the current-practice cell A \mathrm{A} carries more risk under the suite oracle than under its own weak labels, and the fully multi-instance cell D \mathrm{D} carries less suite-oracle risk than cell A \mathrm{A} . GAP \mathrm{GAP} under question splits is 10.23, 8.08, 9.51 and 3.11 points for Kwai-32B, Kwai-14B, Omni-32B and XiYan-32B, and 10.17, 7.86, 9.56 and 2.73 points under database splits; D − A \mathrm{D}{-}\mathrm{A} is − 10.38 -10.38 , − 8.30 -8.30 , − 9.59 -9.59 and − 2.90 -2.90 points under question splits and − 10.70 -10.70 , − 8.02 -8.02 , − 10.30 -10.30 and − 1.26 -1.26 under database splits. The preregistered range of GAP \mathrm{GAP} over the eight checkpoint-and-split combinations is therefore 2.73 to 10.23 points. Generation seeds move these values little: over both split schemes, per-seed GAP \mathrm{GAP} spans 9.90 to 10.41 points for Kwai-32B, 7.51 to 8.30 for Kwai-14B, 9.44 to 9.63 for Omni-32B and 2.62 to 3.13 for XiYan-32B, and per-seed D − A \mathrm{D}{-}\mathrm{A} spans − 10.02 -10.02 to − 10.98 -10.98 , − 7.88 -7.88 to − 8.47 -8.47 , − 9.41 -9.41 to − 10.45 -10.45 and − 1.11 -1.11 to − 2.93 -2.93 points. Under the frozen rule, GAP \mathrm{GAP} is positive for all four checkpoints in both lineages, and the D − A \mathrm{D}{-}\mathrm{A} bar of three points is passed robustly by Kwai-32B, Kwai-14B and Omni-32B and missed by XiYan-32B, by 0.10 points under question splits and by 1.74 points under database splits. 4.3 Labels or partition
blocks.zh: 4.3 标签或分区

blocks.en: The intervention changes two things at once, the labels the certificate is calibrated on and the partition that defines its score, and cells B \mathrm{B} and C \mathrm{C} separate them. At matched nominal level, cell B \mathrm{B} (suite labels on the original partition) is the more conservative of the two, answering 46.6 to 74.0 percent of questions against 74.1 to 92.3 percent for cell D \mathrm{D} at α = 0.10 \alpha=0.10 under question splits, while the two realised risks differ (0.072 to 0.092 against 0.094 to 0.101), so the comparison has to be made at a common risk ceiling. With every distinct top-class mass and the abstain-on-everything point enumerated ( Figure A5 , appendix), at an empirical ceiling of 0.05 cell B \mathrm{B} can only abstain on everything for all four checkpoints while cell D \mathrm{D} answers 58.7, 55.6 and 63.3 percent for Kwai-32B, Kwai-14B and Omni-32B; at 0.075 three checkpoints still cannot answer under the label-only cell while the suite-partition cell answers 67.3, 70.3 and 87.9 percent, Omni-32B being the exception whose label-only cell answers 54.5 percent; at a ceiling of 0.10 the difference closes to 0.4 to 8.9 points, and at 0.125 and 0.15 it closes to 0.0 to 4.1 points. This is an empirical frontier on the full data under a common ceiling rather than a common realised risk, and it is a post-hoc description: within this setting, rebuilding the equivalence classes with the suite is what moves the frontier, and relabelling alone does not.

blocks.en: Two of the six scores never read any oracle, and they understate as much as the four that do. This settles a sufficiency question: coupling between the score and the oracle is not necessary for the understatement, because a score that cannot see the oracle carries it too. A score-free reference quantity makes the point sharper. Call a question a flip question if the answer that cell A \mathrm{A} returns is accepted by the shipped database and rejected by the suite; the flip rate is 10.96, 8.86, 11.02 and 3.35 percent of questions for Kwai-32B, Kwai-14B, Omni-32B and XiYan-32B. On each split, a certificate’s GAP \mathrm{GAP} is the number of held-out flip questions it answers as a share of all held-out questions, so a certificate that never abstains carries the held-out flip rate as its GAP \mathrm{GAP} . Under question splits, abstention leaves 60.8 to 95.0 percent of the flip questions answered across the six scores, and the enrichment of flip questions among answered questions relative to their base rate is 84.0 to 102.5 percent: no tested score removes most of the disagreement, and for five score-and-checkpoint combinations the answered questions are slightly richer in flip questions than the pool. This does not decompose GAP \mathrm{GAP} into a label part and a score part, because GAP \mathrm{GAP} is a joint quantity of the labels and the answered set and different scores answer different questions.

blocks.en: 4.5 Robustness of the measurement
blocks.zh: 4.5 计量的力度

blocks.en: Six post-hoc checks, tabulated in Table A7 (appendix), bound the ways the measurement could be an artefact. Instance cross-fit builds the classes and the calibration labels from one half of each schema’s suite instances and judges correctness on the other half; in all 24 runs GAP \mathrm{GAP} stays positive and D − A \mathrm{D}{-}\mathrm{A} negative, and the held-out suite risk of cell D \mathrm{D} lands at 0.094 to 0.101, so the contrast holds on suite instances the calibration did not see. The same check shows how redundant the suite is for this purpose: the two halves disagree on the label of about 0.6 percent of single-instance classes, 1.9 percent of multi-instance classes and 1.6 percent of top classes, which is why cross-fitting cannot stand in for semantic evidence. The candidates-only partition, which keeps the reference query out of the union-find and uses it only to label a class afterwards, and the gold-free construction, which additionally takes the row-order convention from the compared pair rather than from the reference query, reproduce the question-split GAP \mathrm{GAP} and D − A \mathrm{D}{-}\mathrm{A} of every checkpoint to within 0.03 points ( Appendix D ). Over all 92,378 schema-disjoint 9/10 splits of the 19 schemas, GAP \mathrm{GAP} is positive in 99.96 to 100 percent of splits and D − A \mathrm{D}{-}\mathrm{A} negative in 99.83 to 100 percent for three checkpoints, and in 88.5 to 92.8 and 70.0 to 75.1 percent for XiYan-32B; leaving one schema out moves GAP \mathrm{GAP} by at most 2.5 points (Omni-32B without world_1) and by at most 1.9 points for XiYan-32B (without car_1). Finally, a matched control that replaces every Spider-Realistic question by its one-to-one paired original Spider question, same schemas, reference queries, prompt template and seeds, gives GAP \mathrm{GAP} of 7.48 and 7.25 points and D − A \mathrm{D}{-}\mathrm{A} of − 7.92 -7.92 and − 7.24 -7.24 points for Kwai-14B under question and database splits, against 8.08, 7.86, − 8.30 -8.30 and − 8.02 -8.02 on Spider-Realistic: for Kwai-14B the effect is not created by the paraphrased questions. The false-schema negative control ( Figure A2 , appendix) confirms that the instrument largely abstains when the signal is destroyed: the control cell answers 0 to 11.0 percent of questions.

GAP \mathrm{GAP} is a quantity of cell A \mathrm{A} alone, so drawing m m of each question’s usable candidates without replacement and recounting the shipped-database partition reduces the budget exactly for it. blocks.zh: 页:1 对套房拒绝的一切进行普查

blocks.en: 5.1 Why these populations carry the whole result
blocks.zh: 5.1 国家 为什么这些人口 背负整个结果

blocks.en: GAP \mathrm{GAP} is carried entirely by the answers of cell A \mathrm{A} that the shipped database accepts and the suite rejects, because the suite label refines the shipped-database label: across the 11,351 execution-equivalence classes of the twelve pools, no class is accepted by the suite and rejected by the shipped database. Those answers are the disagreement census: 521 answer occurrences, 240 distinct question-and-SQL cases, 99 questions, 13 schemas. D − A \mathrm{D}{-}\mathrm{A} additionally involves answers both oracles reject, because they cancel inside GAP \mathrm{GAP} and do not cancel between two cells with different partitions; the full census covers every answer that cell A \mathrm{A} or cell D \mathrm{D} returns and the suite rejects: 2,779 occurrences, 742 distinct cases, 203 questions; of those cases, the 240 disagreement cases are carried over with their labels and 502 are labelled for the first time. The two cells return the same SQL on 5,919 of 6,096 answers, 97.1 percent ( Section 6.3 ).

On the disagreement census the two passes agree on the five-way label for 85.0 percent of cases and on the binary semantic-error-or-not label for 92.9 percent, Cohen’s κ \kappa [ 12 ] of 0.787 and 0.801; on the 502 newly labelled cases of the full census they agree for 91.6 and 96.8 percent, κ \kappa of 0.873 and 0.935. blocks.en: Of the 521 answers the shipped database accepts and the suite rejects, the audit labelled 136, or 26.1 percent, semantic errors (65 of the 240 cases). The rest were labelled underspecified questions (195 answers, 37.4 percent), suspected reference-query defects (107, 20.5 percent) or synthetic-instance defects (83, 15.9 percent); and no case received the comparator-artefact label. The semantic errors concentrate: the 65 cases fall on 30 questions in 7 schemas, of the 13 schemas the disagreement census touches, and are dominated by grouping by name rather than key and by filters attached to the wrong entity. Their share is similar across checkpoints, 22.2 to 29.4 percent of each checkpoint’s audited answers.

blocks.en: 5.4 The full census and the suspected reference-query defects
blocks.zh: 5.4 国家 全面普查和疑似参考血清缺陷

blocks.en: In the broader census of 2,779 answers rejected by the suite, representing 742 distinct cases across 203 questions, the audit labelled 972 answers, 35.0 percent, semantic errors (288 cases); on the two checkpoints whose answers two SQL experts judged, the experts call wrong 36.8 and 36.3 percent of the answers the suite rejects ( Section 7.1 ). The audit assigned the suspected reference-defect label to 213 cases, 887 answers, flagging 73 of the 508 questions as having at least one suspected defective reference query, and the preregistered blinded audit of Appendix G supports the flag: experts judge 54.8 percent of the flagged questions defective, against 20.0 percent of examined questions without the flag and 7.5 percent of questions on which the suite rejected no answer, a margin of 34.8 points over the examined control where the preregistered rule asks for 25. Thirty-four of the flagged questions carry at least one non-borderline suspected-defect judgement agreed by both passes, twenty-nine carry an agreed judgement that at least one pass marked borderline, and ten depend entirely on adjudication; the experts confirmed 91.2, 27.6 and 10.0 percent of the three groups, so how strongly the AI labelled a question is what predicts whether an expert agrees with it. Weighting the audit’s three strata by their sizes, a post-hoc estimate puts a defective reference query on 17.5 percent of the 508 questions, with an interval of 12.2 to 22.8 percent. Table A3 and Figure A1 in the appendix give the full distributions by case, by answer and by schema; world_1 alone carries 68 of the 213 cases on 26 questions.

blocks.en: The suspected defects are not scattered; they recur in a handful of families, each mechanically visible once the reference query is executed. The examples below quote the audited cases, with the benchmark’s spacing before punctuation removed, and we executed each reference query on the shipped database ourselves. A case-sensitive string literal returns nothing on the database it was written for: for “What is the mobile phone number of the student named Timmothy Ward?” the reference query filters on first_name = ’timmothy’ and last_name = ’ward’ , and the shipped database stores Timmothy and Ward , so the reference returns an empty table while the model’s answer returns the number. A numeric comparison or ordering runs on a text-typed column: the MPG column of the car database is stored as text, so the reference query for “Which model saves the most gasoline?” orders lexicographically and returns citroen , while the model’s answer casts to a number and returns mazda . A join without a join condition: the reference for “What are the first name and last name of the professionals who have done treatment cheaper than average?” joins professionals to treatments without an ON clause, returning fifteen names where the joined query returns five. A negated filter: the reference for “What are the names of the dogs for which the owner spent more than 1000 for treatment?” selects the dogs NOT IN the set that spent more than 1000. An incomplete projection: “List the id and all lines” of an address is answered with two of the three address-line columns. A set operation on names: “students’ first names who have both cats and dogs” is answered by intersecting first names, which merges different students who share one. And a reversed or missing restriction: “the weight of the youngest dog” is answered by the youngest pet of any type. Some of these families disagree with the model’s answer on the shipped database itself; others, such as the set operation on names and the missing pet-type restriction, return the same rows on the shipped database and are exposed only on suite instances that contain the collision. In every family the AI audit labelled the model’s answer as the more faithful reading of the question.
blocks.zh: 疑似缺陷不是分散的,而是在少数家庭重复出现,一旦执行参考查询,每个家庭就会机械地看到。 下面的例子引用了经审计的案例,删除了基准的间隔,然后我们自己在运出的数据库中进行了每一个查询。 一个对大小写敏感的字符串字串在数据库中不返回它为它写的东西:“名为Timmothy Ward的学生的手机号码是多少? ” 的参考查询过滤器在first_name = 'Timmothy ' and last_name = 'ward'上,运出的数据库存储Timmothy和Ward,所以在模型的答案返回数字时,引用返回一个空表。 一个数字比较或命令运行在文本类型的列上:汽车数据库的MPG列被存储为文本,所以“哪个型号节省了最多的汽油?”的参考查询从词典上命令并返回柑橘,而该型号的答案则投向一个数字并返回mazda。 一个没有加入条件的加入:“做过比一般便宜治疗的专业人员的姓名和姓是什么?” 一个否定的过滤器:“所有者花费1 000多只用于治疗的狗的名称是什么?” 一个不完整的预测:地址的“编号和所有行”用三个地址线栏中的两个回答。 以名字命名的一套操作: " 既有猫又有狗的同学的姓 " ,通过交叉的姓来回答,这些名字将不同的同名学生合并在一起。 而一个倒转或缺失的限制:“最年轻的狗的重量”是由任何类型的最年轻的宠物回答的。 其中一些家庭不同意模型在运出数据库本身的答案;另一些家庭,如名称上的设定操作和缺失的宠物类型限制,在运出数据库中返回同一行,仅在包含碰撞的套房实例中曝光. 在每一个家庭中,大赦国际的审计都认为模型的答案是对问题的更忠实的理解。

blocks.en: 5.5 Mechanical signatures are associated with the label
blocks.zh: 5.5 机械签名与标签相关

blocks.en: The audit read the result tables of the reference query and the returned query on the first instance where they disagree, and a mechanical signature of that difference, computed before any label, is strongly associated with the label assigned in the disagreement census ( Figure A1 b, appendix); this is an in-sample association with AI labels, not a validated predictor. When the two tables partially overlap, 93.8 percent of cases were labelled semantic errors (15 of 16); when the reference returns no rows on the instance, 53.3 percent; when the reference’s rows are a subset of the returned rows, 34.4 percent; when the tables are disjoint, 25.0 percent (31 of 124). Five signatures never received the semantic-error label: differing duplicate multiplicity only (25 cases), the returned rows being a subset of the reference’s (14), a different column count (9), the returned query returning no rows (3) and row order only (2), together 53 cases and 95 answers that the suite rejects and the audit attributes to the question, the reference or a synthetic instance rather than to the system. Disagreement breadth points the same way: cases that disagree on at most 10 percent of the instances were labelled semantic errors 17.9 percent of the time, cases that disagree on more than half of the instances 31.7 percent. Within the audited population, the signature lets a reviewer read the rejections most likely to be labelled semantic errors first.
blocks.zh: 审计阅读了参考查询的结果表和它们不同意的第一次返回的查询,在任何标签之前计算出的这一差异的机械签字与分歧普查中指定的标签(图A1b,附录)密切相关;这是与AI标签的抽样联系,而不是经过验证的预测器。 当两个表格部分重叠时,93.8%的案件被贴上语义错误的标签(16起中有15起);当参考文献不返回例中的行时,53.3%;当参考文献的行是返回行的子集时,34.4%;当表格不相连时,25.0%(124起中有31起)。 5个签名从未收到过语义-error标签:不同的重复复数(25个案例),返回的行是参考文献(14)的一个子集,不同的列数(9个),返回的查询返回无列数(3个),仅排数(2个),加之套件拒绝的53个案例和95个答案以及审计属性的问题、参考文献或合成实例而不是系统。 分歧的广度也指向了同样的方式:在最多10%的情况下有分歧的案件被标注为语义错误的案件占17.9%,在超过一半的情况下有分歧的案件占31.7%。 在被审计的人群中,签名让审查者首先阅读最有可能被贴上语义错误标签的拒绝.

blocks.en: 6 Re-scoring the certificate under the census labels
blocks.zh: 6个 在普查标签下重新评分证书

blocks.en: This section re-scores the certificate under the labels of Section 5 . The suite oracle stays the intervention throughout: cell D \mathrm{D} is still built and calibrated on the suite, and only the yardstick against which held-out answers are judged changes. Four nested conventions decide which rejected answers count as wrong: wide, the label is semantic error or synthetic-instance defect; narrow, the audit’s final label is semantic error; agreed, both passes independently said semantic error; unanimous, agreed and neither pass called the case borderline. Everything the suite accepts is left as accepted, because no accepted answer was examined. All of it is post hoc and rests on those AI labels.
blocks.zh: 本节以第5节的标签重新记录证书。 套房预告片会一直停留在插座上: 单元格 D\ mathrm{ D} 仍然在套房上构建和校准, 只有被判断为被搁置的答案的尺度才会被修改 。 四个嵌入式的公约决定哪些拒绝答案算错:宽,标签是语义错误或合成-内存缺陷;窄,审计的最终标签是语义错误;同意,两者都独立通过语义错误;一致,同意,两条标签都不称为案例边界线. 套房接受的每件东西都照原样,因为没有检查任何接受的答案. 所有这一切都是临时的 并基于这些AI标签。

blocks.en: 6.1 The sign needs labels on both sides of the oracle
blocks.zh: 6.1 国家 该标志需要在甲骨文的两侧设置标签

blocks.en: Figure 1 b and Table A4 (appendix) give GAP \mathrm{GAP} under each convention. Relabelling the rejected side with the disagreement census alone leaves GAP \mathrm{GAP} positive, 2.26, 2.37, 2.54 and 1.00 points for Kwai-32B, Kwai-14B, Omni-32B and XiYan-32B under the narrow convention, down from 10.23, 8.08, 9.50 and 3.11; it cannot turn negative, because every convention keeps the suite label a refinement of the weak label on that population. Relabelling with the full census reverses the sign: − 4.99 -4.99 , − 3.37 -3.37 , − 4.25 -4.25 and − 4.22 -4.22 points under question splits and − 3.28 -3.28 to − 5.28 -5.28 under database splits. The mechanism is visible in the labels. The full census also covers answers that both oracles reject, and when the audit labels such an answer a suspected reference-query defect or an underspecified question, the shipped database has rejected it too; both oracles over-reject on those questions, and the shipped database’s over-rejection inflates the reported risk the certificate is calibrated on, so that the certificate is conservative rather than optimistic under the audited yardstick. Under the narrow convention the current-practice cell of Kwai-32B carries 0.0482 at α = 0.10 \alpha=0.10 under question splits, three-seed mean, against 0.0981 under its own weak labels.

blocks.en: That reversal comes from auditing one side of the oracle. The census examined every answer the suite rejects and none that it accepts: cell A \mathrm{A} has 4,690 suite-accepted answer occurrences, 1,580 distinct question-and-SQL outputs, and a relabelling that only exculpates rejected answers can only lower the audited risk. Reference-query defects cut the other way as well: an answer that agrees with a defective reference on every instance is, if the label is right, evidence of being wrong, and 259 accepted occurrences (4.2 percent of all answers), 102 distinct outputs, fall on the 73 questions the audit flagged; counting all of them as wrong, an extreme bound given in Table A4 , already restores a positive sign for XiYan-32B.
blocks.zh: 这种逆转来自对神谕一方的审计. 人口普查检查了每个拒绝的答案,没有接受的答案:A\mathrm{A}单元格有4,690个接受的答案事件,1,580个不同的疑问和SQL输出,重新标注只有被否定的答案才能降低被审计的风险。 参考-清点缺陷也切换了另一种方式:如果标签正确的话,每个实例上都有一个有缺陷的参考的答案就是错误的证据,259个公认的事件(占所有答案的4.2%),102个不同的产出落在审计标注的73个问题上;将所有问题都算作错误,表A4给出的一个极端界限,已经恢复了XiYan-32B的积极迹象。

blocks.en: 6.2 The D minus A contrast under audited labels
blocks.zh: 6.2 (中文(简体) ). 审计标签下的 D 减 A 对比

blocks.en: Table 4 gives D − A \mathrm{D}{-}\mathrm{A} under the same conventions; its three-seed mean stays negative under every one.
